pages.head: Welcome
pages.html:
Welcome

Coins and Score is a Starter: a small game that shows a few Game-Maker ideas, with signs in the levels that say what you are looking at. It has three short levels and takes a few minutes to finish.

Play it first. Then open it in Game-Maker (Edit a copy on the home page keeps the original safe) and read the pages below, which say where each thing in the levels is made.

The keys

Left and Right walk. Space jumps. Up and Down climb a ladder. F2 shows your score and lives. Walk into the door at the end of a level to go on. There is nothing to fight and nothing that hurts.

pages.head: Level 1: Coins Add Points
pages.html:
Level 1: Coins Add Points

Walk right and touch the coins. Each one is worth ten points and is gone once you have it. Six lie along the ground, and five more run along a ledge up a ladder. That makes 110 points. The COINS ADD POINTS sign says so, and F2 SHOWS YOUR SCORE says where to look: the score is not drawn on the play screen. Press F2 to see it, then any key to carry on.

pages.head: How this level is made
pages.html:
How level 1 is made

  • The coin. Open coins.bbl in the blocks editor and pick the coin block. On its Touch tab, Score points is 10, and Becomes block is sky, so the coin is gone once you have it.
  • Where the score is shown. Game-Maker keeps the score for you and has no place for it on the play screen. F2 opens a status page with the score, the lives, the hit points and the time. That page comes with Game-Maker. Nothing in this game draws it.
  • The ledge. Open one.map in the map editor. The ledge is a row of grass over dirt, reached by a ladder. The coins along it are the same coin block.
  • The signs. Each sign is a few ordinary blocks side by side, with the words drawn in their pictures. Change the words in the blocks editor and play again.
  • The exit. A scene link joins the door at the end to the next level. Open coins.gam in the scenes editor and look at the links of the Coins Add Points scene.

pages.head: Level 2: Some Are Worth More
pages.html:
Level 2: Some Are Worth More

Not every pickup pays the same. A coin is worth 10, and the A COIN IS WORTH 10 sign says so. Up a ladder, three blue gems sit on a ledge, each worth 50. Further on, a gray rock lies in the path, and the A ROCK TAKES 20 AWAY sign warns you. Walk into it and your score goes down by 20. You can jump over it to keep your points. The level holds 40 + 150 + 30 = 220 points, or 200 if you take the rock.

pages.head: How this level is made
pages.html:
How level 2 is made

  • Different points. Open coins.bbl and compare the coin, gem and rock blocks. They are the same kind of block with a different Score points on the Touch tab: 10, 50 and −20. Each one also has Becomes block set to sky, so it is gone once touched.
  • A pickup that costs. Score points can be below zero. Touching the rock subtracts from the score, and Game-Maker plays its own sound for it. Nothing stops the score going negative, so a level that takes points away is best kept small.
  • The gems. Open two.map in the map editor. The gems are on a ledge of grass over dirt, reached by a ladder. To change what a gem is worth, edit the gem block, not the map.
  • The exit. The door at the end links to the next level in coins.gam.

pages.head: Level 3: Points Are Not Lives
pages.html:
Level 3: Points Are Not Lives

Ten coins lie in a row, and the COINS ARE ONLY POINTS sign tells you what they do: they add 100 to the score and nothing else. Press F2 and your lives are still 3. Further on, a red heart sits on a ledge up a ladder, with a A HEART ADDS A LIFE sign. Take it and press F2 again: 4 lives. The heart is worth no points at all.

Many games give an extra life at a certain score. Game-Maker does not. Its score only counts up (or down), and nothing in the engine watches it for a limit. A life comes from a block that adds to the lives counter, like the heart.

pages.head: How this level is made
pages.html:
How level 3 is made

  • The heart. Open coins.bbl and pick the heart block. On its Touch tab, Effect counter is set to 1 (the lives counter) and Effect amount to 1. Score points is 0, and Becomes block is sky. Game-Maker plays its own sound when a life is added.
  • Starting lives. Open hero.chr in the character editor. The hero starts with 3 lives; that number is on the character, not in the level.
  • Why coins give no life. The coin block only has Score points. The score is a plain number that nothing checks against a limit, so a life has to come from a block.
  • Where lives show. F2 shows them on the same status page as the score. The lives also decide what happens when the hero falls: with one or more left, the level starts over.
  • The exit. The last door links to the The End scene in coins.gam, which plays the ending.

pages.head: Make it yours
pages.html:
Make it yours

Try one change at a time, and play after each:

  • Change a gem’s Score points to 100 and play level 2 again.
  • Make the rock cost 50, or cost nothing.
  • Put a heart on the ground in level 3 where you cannot miss it.
  • Give the hero 5 lives in hero.chr and press F2 on the first level.

The home page’s Starters tab has more small games like this one.
